trades.title: Will McDonald's report Above 2.5% global comparable sales growth in Q2 2026?
trades.rationale: Q1 2026 global comps 3.8% (US 3.9%, IOM 3.9%). Q2 threshold 2.5% — needs 1.3-point deceleration to miss. Revenue growth 9.4%, FCF strong. Warning: stock -4.9% in 20d, below both MAs. Adjusted from 63% to 58% on stock weakness signal.

trades.title: Best AI in Dec 2026? — Claude: Anthropic
trades.rationale: Market prices Claude at 64% to win best AI by Dec 2026. AI landscape is fragmented — Claude leads coding, Gemini leads reasoning, GPT leads agentic tasks. 7 months is an eternity in AI. Estimate 45% — market overconfident in single-model dominance.

trades.title: Best AI in Dec 2026? — Gemini: Google
trades.rationale: Gemini 3.1 Pro leads hardest reasoning benchmarks (GPQA Diamond 94.3%, ARC-AGI-2 77.1%) at lowest major-lab price. If best AI weights reasoning, Gemini has a strong case. Market at 16% feels too low.

trades.title: Best AI in Dec 2026? — ChatGPT: OpenAI
trades.rationale: GPT-5.4 is the best all-rounder with the largest ecosystem. If best AI uses a composite or user preference metric, OpenAI has a strong argument. Market at 14% seems too low. Third leg of Claude-NO / Gemini-YES / GPT-YES position — hits 3-trade correlation cap on best-AI concept.

trades.title: When will SpaceX IPO? — Before Jul 1, 2026
trades.rationale: SpaceX S-1 confirmed filed May 20. Roadshow June 8, pricing June 18-30, first trade late June. Market at 98% YES (IPO before Jul 1). Execution risk: pricing of June 28-30 could push first trading day to July 1+. Largest IPO in history adds complexity. Musk comments diverged from filing per CNBC. Estimate 88% YES — buying NO at 3c as a low-cost timing-risk hedge.

trades.title: Will Apple release iPhone 18 before Jan 1, 2027?
trades.rationale: iPhone 18 Pro confirmed September 2026 (event Sep 8-14, ship Sep 18). Market at 16% seems wrong IF any iPhone 18 family model counts. KEY RISK: base iPhone 18 delayed to spring 2027 — resolution criteria ambiguity is the main risk here, not the event itself. Sized at 10% cap.

key_signals.resolution_risk: Does 'iPhone 18' require the base model or does Pro count?

trades.title: Will Chipotle report Above 1% comparable restaurant sales in Q2 2026?
trades.rationale: Chipotle guided ~1% comp sales in Q2 — right at the threshold. Three consecutive negative comp quarters. Stock -6.27% in 20d, earnings -17.9%. Market at 89% YES overestimates. Estimate 60% YES. NO at 12c.

trades.title: Will Chipotle report Above 4160 total restaurant count in Q2 2026?
trades.rationale: Q1 2026 ended at 4,090 locations. Full-year target 350-370 new units; Q2 must accelerate vs Q1's 49 openings. Net additions of 65-80 = 4,155-4,170 — straddles 4,160 threshold. Lean 60% YES. Second Chipotle position — hits correlation cap.

trades.title: Will OpenAI or Anthropic IPO first? — Anthropic
trades.rationale: OpenAI: confidential S-1 filed May 22, September target, Goldman/Morgan leading. Anthropic: no S-1 filed, October internal target. OpenAI has a 4-5 month process lead. Market at 25% for Anthropic-first is too generous. Estimate 15% YES.

trades.title: When will Anthropic officially announce an IPO? Before Oct 1, 2026
trades.rationale: No S-1 filed as of May 30. SEC review takes 60-90 days from filing — barely possible by Oct 1. Market at 66% YES feels overconfident. Estimate 50% YES. NO at 38c gives +12c edge.

skips.title: Will Wendy's report Above 0% US same-restaurant sales in Q2 2026?
skips.reason: Q1 US comps -7.8%. Edge only +2c — below 5c threshold. Market fairly priced.

skips.title: Will Altria report Above 13.5B cigarette shipments in Q2 2026?
skips.reason: Q1 was 13.867B (above threshold) but -2.4% YoY declining. Estimate 82% YES vs market 98%. Edge for NO = +15c but insufficient baseline data (need Q2 2025 shipments) to confidently go against 98% consensus.

skips.title: Will Paramount's takeover of Warner Brothers succeed before July 2027?
skips.reason: Shareholders approved April 2026, Q3 2026 close expected. Market 83%, my estimate 80%. No meaningful edge.
